metrics.preferred_job_title: DGM Admin, HR / IR & Legal Affairs
metrics.profile_summary: Seasoned leader with over 25 years of experience in Administration, Industrial Relations, Legal Affairs, and HR Strategy. Expert in labor law compliance, dispute resolution, and organizational resilience.

experience.role: Deputy General Manager - HR & Admin / Legal Affairs
experience.description: Leads company-wide administrative, legal, and external affairs functions, including CBA negotiations and government liaison.
Implemented workforce rationalization and facilitated training on HRM, legal, and ISO compliance.

experience.role: Admin Officer to Deputy Manager - Personnel & Admin
experience.description: Managed IR activities, land/legal matters, and worker welfare coordination with EOBI and Social Security.

strengths: Deep expertise in legal and labor affairs
Strong administrative and policy development skills
weaknesses: No experience in marketing or brand management
Lack of technical skills in GA4 and ad platform reporting
Professional background is entirely unrelated to the job requirements
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly experienced HR and Legal professional with no relevant marketing experience or technical skills required for a Marketing Manager role.
